subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently replace the iPhone tab bar with this sidebar-only root-navigation model after the listed session and recovery-path fixes land?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes a major established navigation surface rather than making a narrow bug repair; the protected maintainer label and prior review require explicit product ownership beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Confirm sidebar-only navigation
options.body: Keep the redesign, after fixing the session completeness/search and approvals remediation regressions.

options.title: Retain a phone tab-bar fallback
options.body: Keep the sidebar features but preserve a tab-bar path if maintainers want lower-risk migration for existing iPhone navigation habits.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the root-navigation replacement until the desired iPhone information architecture is documented and approved.

recommendation.title: Confirm sidebar-only navigation
recommendation.body: Keep the redesign, after fixing the session completeness/search and approvals remediation regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: The related Overview-retirement direction and this branch both establish the proposed cross-surface navigation model.
